empty.title: No projects yet
empty.hint: Create the first project — categories and tasks will live inside it

home.greeting: Hello, {name} — here is your portfolio at a glance

empty.title: Nothing is assigned to you
empty.hint: Tasks where you are the owner will gather here, across every project

gantt.empty: This project has no categories yet. Create a category — tasks live inside it

summary.late: The project ends {end} — {days} after the {deadline} deadline

gantt.caption: The magenta tick is the original deadline; the “+N d” label shows how far the date slipped. A magenta arrow is a violated dependency: the task started before its blocker was done.

share.title: Public link to the project
share.hint: The link opens the project for reading without an account: no internal notes, no assignees
share.reissue_warning: A new link kills the old one instantly — an address you already sent will stop opening
share.disabled: Public links are switched off: by the installation or by the organization

comments.title: Comments
comments.closed: The project owner has closed comments
comments.disabled: Comments are off for this link

public.revoked_hint: Ask whoever sent it to you for a new one

members.title: Members
members.emails_hint: One per line. Leave empty to issue a link only — whoever opens it accepts it
members.issued_hint: The link is visible only now: the server does not remember it, only its hash
members.mail_failed: The email did not go out — copy the link

invite.title: Invite to the organization
invite.emails_hint: Several at once — separated by commas or line breaks
invite.link_only_hint: With no address you get a link invitation: it belongs to whoever opens it
invite.projects_hint: A client sees only the projects ticked here

issued.once: Copy the link now: there is nowhere to take it a second time — the server keeps only its fingerprint

accept.title: Invitation
accept.bearer: This is a link invitation: it works for whoever opened it
accept.wrong_account: The invitation was issued to {email}. Sign out and sign in with that address

invite.bearer: This invitation is not tied to an address: whoever opens the link accepts it
invite.sign_in_first: Sign in or register to accept — then come back to this link
invite.another_account: This invitation is addressed to {email}. You are signed in as someone else — sign out and back in

plan.reapprove_warning: Re-approving moves the baseline: shifts will be measured from the new dates
plan.beyond_plan_explained: Added after the plan was approved — there is no baseline to compare with

settings.threshold_hint: A change that moves further than this from the approved plan needs a reason
settings.slug_taken: That address is taken. A free one:

org.name: Name

project.name: Name

profile.title: Profile
